statistical_contract.marginal_errors: Published approximately Gaussian standard errors, not deterministic error bounds
statistical_contract.joint_covariance: Not supplied across the two experiments; no exact joint likelihood claimed
statistical_contract.primary_joint_region: Bonferroni rectangle from two 97.5 percent marginal intervals, conditional on Gaussian marginal coverage
statistical_contract.secondary_fit: Independent Gaussian approximation only; not the collaborations' combined likelihood

theory_contract.baseline: P981 adopted SM charged-current branch in the published extraction conventions
theory_contract.radiative_and_acceptance_matching: Adopt publication conventions; no new all-orders theory remainder or detector-level reanalysis
theory_contract.higher_dimensional_coefficients: No arbitrary unspecialized P981 EFT family is claimed to predict the baseline
